lines.text: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved and abides forever.
As the mountains surround Bethlehem, the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
The scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous.
The psalm asks the LORD to do good to those who are good and to the upright in heart.
The LORD will banish those who turn to crooked ways with the evildoers, and peace be upon Judah.
